description: This file defines the interface 'GroupReadPlatformService', which provides methods for retrieving group-related data within the Fineract platform. Being an interface, it specifies method signatures related to fetching group data, templates, and lookup information, but does not contain implementations.

classes.name: GroupReadPlatformService
classes.description: Interface defining methods for reading group data, including retrieval of templates, all groups, specific groups, and lookup data.

methods.name: retrieveTemplate
methods.description: Retrieves a template or default data for creating or viewing a group, based on office ID and group type.

methods.name: retrievePagedAll
methods.description: Retrieves a paged list of all groups based on search parameters and pagination settings.

methods.name: retrieveAll
methods.description: Retrieves all groups matching search parameters without pagination.

methods.name: retrieveOne
methods.description: Retrieves detailed data for a specific group identified by groupId.

methods.name: retrieveGroupsForLookup
methods.description: Retrieves a collection of groups for lookup purposes, filtered by office ID.

methods.name: retrieveGroupWithClosureReasons
methods.description: Retrieves group data that includes closure reasons.

methods.name: retrieveGroupAndMembersDetails
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about a group including its members, identified by groupId.
